fomod.Name: Apocalypse - Enderal Patch
fomod.Author: Enai Siaion (records) / Zenderal (Enderal patch)
fomod.Description:
Enderal: Forgotten Stories SE patch for Apocalypse - Magic of Skyrim by Enai Siaion.
Apocalypse does not load in Enderal at all. Enderal runs Skyrim SE 1.5.97, and that engine silently refuses any plugin whose header form version is 1.71 - no warning, no log entry, the plugin is simply absent. Apocalypse is 1.71, so none of its 373 spells have ever been in your game. No patch loaded on top can fix that, because a patch must declare Apocalypse as a master and the engine has already skipped it. So this REPLACES the plugin with a rebuild at form version 1.70, under the same filename, keeping Enai's BSAs loading.
With the plugin loading, the rest is fixed properly: all 160 spell tomes are stocked directly by six named Enderal merchants tiered by their gold, and the scrolls seeded into Enderal's own loot lists - Apocalypse's own distribution targets 54 vanilla Skyrim leveled lists, none of which exist here. Tome and scroll prices are rescaled onto Enderal's economy. The 67 staff recipes are removed along with the Dragonborn master, the Tamriel worldspace override that was overwriting Enderal's prologue house is replaced, the Daedra and Dwemer summons are cut, healing spells are made to raise Arcane Fever the way Enderal's own healing does, and spells named after Elder Scrolls gods and mages are renamed from Enderal's lore.
REQUIRES Apocalypse - Magic of Skyrim 10.2.3 installed first, for its assets. Install this over it and let it overwrite. No DLC and no other plugin needs enabling.
